task: Change only the man's pale shirt to solid red; preserve garment style/details, the woman's clothing, people, background, camera, action order and timing.

requested_color_change.evidence: The man's shirt is consistently saturated red in the sampled output rather than the pale source shirt. Natural shading and folds remain visible; solid red is not interpreted as requiring an identical flat RGB value across all fabric pixels.

evidence: The woman's clothing remains pale in all nine compared states; grass and sky retain their broad colors.
No conspicuous large red spill onto the woman's clothing, skin, or background was seen in the inspected images.

The man's collared-shirt and long/rolled-sleeve silhouette remains recognizable. Fabric folds, local shape and boundary details differ; strict preservation of the exact fabric, tailoring and every detail has not been established.
The same two-person arrangement and broad appearance remain recognizable, but no biometric identity or fine face/hand fidelity metric was performed.
Frame 0: facing each other with the man's hand against the woman's head.
Frames 15 and 30: facial approach/contact and kissing pose.
Frames 60 through 105: the woman's head rests against his chest in an embrace.
Frame 123: the embrace continues with her face turned toward the camera.
actions_and_timing.limitation: These nine corresponding-index observations support preservation of the main event order and coarse phase, but do not measure exact per-frame alignment, transition timing, speed, or every intervening motion.

composition_background_and_camera.evidence: The couple, grassy landscape and pale sky occupy broadly corresponding regions. No major viewpoint substitution or scene replacement was observed in these comparisons.
composition_background_and_camera.limitation: Local contours and background/subject positions are not asserted to match exactly. No camera trajectory, optical flow, geometric registration or perceptual comparison was measured.

obvious_artifacts.evidence: No inspected frame is black, blank or dominated by a major geometric collapse. Clothing, faces and embracing arms remain recognizable.
obvious_artifacts.limitation: This does not exclude subtle anatomy errors, texture changes, transient defects or flicker between samples.

conclusion_zh: 独立看过三张对照图的九个时点及A首/中/尾原图后，确认男士衬衫换红在抽样画面中明确达成，女士衣服未明显换色，主要动作顺序和相位与源视频对应，未见大幅换视角、黑屏或整体畸变。但局部衣褶/形状细节并非严格不变，不能据抽帧宣称全程流畅无闪烁、精确时序/相机保持、音频合格或完全等质。
